descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S28 「Post-Round 上的 Ask，医院：没存体格检查时问 What did the exam show?，回答说没有，不编造正常结果」 Ask on Post-Round, Hospital: 'What did the exam show?' with no exam stored says none and invents no normals

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi …（TFA-92593 AC 2；TFA-92593 AC 3；TFA-92593 AC 6；TFA-92593 AC 9；UAT 3.4；UAT TC-17）
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and …（UAT 3.2）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient whose note reads 'PHYSICAL EXAM / Not dictated.' and whose stored data holds no exam finding

When Type the question 'What did the exam show?' in the Post-Round Ask sheet

Then The answer says no exam is documented and gives no exam finding

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：mustInclude one way of saying the exam is not on file (the runner's saysNone pattern knows labs, results and data, not 'exam ... not dictated', so it is not used here); mustNotInclude the normals a model supplies by default (3.4: no invented exam findings or normals). aiCheck group TC-17-ask

在哪跑：dev 单元 U49；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S28 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
